title: ofKeyReleased
description: `ofKeyReleased` listens for key-release events and outputs them as either a simplified list containing the key or a full list containing type, key, keycode, scancode, and codepoint. The listener is enabled by default and can be toggled with `setEnabled` (0 disables, 1 enables); its listening order defaults to 50 and can be changed with `setOrder`.
